entities.summary: Lucien Weiler was a Luxembourgish politician and jurist. He was a member of the Christian Social People's Party, and served as President of the Chamber of Deputies from 3 August 2004 to 7 June 2009. He was first elected to the Chamber at the 1984 election, representing the Nord circonscription.
